proposal.description: Supervisor's enable input takes the switch-press edge pulse en_switch_rise instead of the debounced switch level
proposal.reason: With the switch held on, g_en is high for only the one clock of the press pulse, so the supervisor leaves OFF to S_SS and drops back almost at once. En never stays high and the converter never reaches S_RUN or PGOOD.

proposal.description: Switch-press edge detector compares the delayed debounced copy with the synchronised but undebounced switch
proposal.reason: en_switch_rise is high for the whole 20 ms debounce interval and on any bounce, even one the debouncer rejects. reg_file then re-asserts spi_enable after a host disable on a bounce that never registers as a press, so the converter can restart.

proposal.description: CP_trig goes through the fault-flag input_debounce like OTP and UVLO, though the header says fault_arbiter's rolling window is its only filter
proposal.reason: Valley-current events last part of one switching cycle, far shorter than the debounce assert time, so they never reach fault_arbiter. Repeated overcurrent then never raises window_trip, and the supervisor never goes to S_HICCUP; En stays high.

proposal.description: PGOOD_comp is debounced before pgood_gen, so the deassert the header requires to be immediate is delayed by the debounce release time
proposal.reason: When the output comparator leaves the window during S_RUN, PGOOD and switch_supply stay high for the debounce release time instead of dropping on the next clocks. PGOOD also rises later after the comparator first enters the window.

proposal.description: pgood_gen is qualified on the gate-driver enable En instead of run_active, so soft-start counts as running
proposal.reason: En is also high in S_SS. If PGOOD_comp is in window during soft-start for the qualify delay, PGOOD and switch_supply assert before SS_done moves the supervisor to S_RUN.

proposal.description: strike_counter's clean-run streak is gated on En instead of run_active, so it is not broken by soft-start time
proposal.reason: After a hiccup, cycles in S_SS already count toward clean_run_target. strike_level clears earlier than it should, so Red_LED1 stops blinking early and the next hiccup cool-down is shorter.

proposal.description: Hiccup back-off is scaled by the configured strike limit max_strikes instead of the current strike_level
proposal.reason: Even the first hiccup after a clean history uses the longest back-off. The time En stays low in S_HICCUP before returning to S_SS is longer than the base cool-down.

proposal.description: reg_file's status PGOOD bit reports the synchronised output comparator instead of the qualified PGOOD
proposal.reason: A host status read during soft-start, in hiccup, or inside the qualify delay shows PGOOD set while the PGOOD pin is low.

proposal.description: reg_file's over-temperature status bit takes the undebounced OTP flag, unlike the debounced one the supervisor acts on
proposal.reason: A status read during the OTP debounce interval, or after a glitch the debouncer rejects, reports OTP while En is still high and Red_LED2 is off. The header requires telemetry to match what the supervisor acts on.

proposal.description: reg_file's latch status bit reports the CPLD's own trip drive latch_out instead of the SCR latch read-back
proposal.reason: When the external SCR latch is set by analog protection without a strike trip, En is forced low but a host status read shows no latch.
